facts.text: Under the Ferris Pledge, incoming first-year Michigan residents eligible for a Pell Grant have their full tuition and required fees covered by scholarships and grants.

sources.title: Ferris Pledge | Zero Out-of-Pocket Expenses | Ferris State University
sources.quote: The Ferris Pledge covers the full cost of tuition and required fees by combining federal and state scholarships and grants with other Ferris financial aid options.

sources.title: Ferris Pledge | Zero Out-of-Pocket Expenses | Ferris State University
sources.quote: Be an incoming first-year undergraduate and a Michigan resident admitted to a degree program for the fall semester. Meet all of the eligibility requirements for a Pell Grant.
